title: Astrid
description: Run Astrid, the video editor, on your computer. Open it at astrid.haus, or install fully local to run the editor here too. Recommended selection: autostart on, terminal command on, detected agent skills on, skill copies off. With autostart on, Pinokio owns startup; no login service is registered. Detected agent skills are enabled for supported agents; skill copies are kept off. Install accepts these choices. Beta.
